facts.availability_summary: Six of nineteen products are on sale: shipcheck as a Claude Code plugin, and FlirtGym, FlipStage, Hatch Window, MoveWitness and Vocabdrift on the App Store. The other thirteen are listed in this file with the status of each one. No release dates are published, because Apple sets them and does not announce them in advance.
